jobs.title: Data Analyst, Macro Analytics
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts, data scientists, and engineers learn and grow together. You'll work with some of Stripe's most fundamental and exciting data, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business insights through analyses and data storytelling.

Responsibilities

Work with Treasury Finance, Finance & Strategy, Risk and Engineering to build out analytics and observability framework for Stripe's financial position
Investigate macro signals and build analytical frameworks that inform financial planning and strategic decisions
Develop targeted observability and performance analytics for both standard and event-driven environments, providing key insights to senior leadership on Stripe’s business position as macro/market conditions shift
Understand and leverage Stripe's data assets to analyze financial performance and develop scalable data foundations for existing and emerging analytical needs
Work with heterogeneous and unstructured data to develop insights and recommendations
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to build data pipelines, models, and infrastructure that serve business needs
Support ongoing reporting, stakeholder communications, and information requests across Treasury Finance and Finance & Strategy

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

Must be located in New York or willing to relocate as this role is hybrid
3–6 years of experience in Data Research & Analysis, Risk Modeling & Analysis roles, Business Intelligence and Data Engineering, building data pipelines and analyzing large datasets to solve problems
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Strong statistical knowledge and business intuition
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Experience in analytics in FinTech, banking, investment management, corporate finance, treasury, or financial services
Expertise in visualization and using data insights to make recommendations and achieve goals
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple concurrent projects with strong attention to detail
Comfortable collaborating across functions to identify data analytics problems and execute solutions with technical rigor and data-driven insights
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related technical field
Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or FinTech company
Prior experience in macro analytics, corporate finance, financial planning, and portfolio management
Familiarity with financial and accounting data, time-series data, macroeconomic analysis or economic indicator development
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Hadoop and Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $134,000 - $201,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

Problem-solving with a purpose.

Alongside customer counterparts, you’ll tackle mission-critical and complex problems – we’re way beyond “turn it off and on again” issues. You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

What We Can Offer

A crafted employee experience designed to foster professional growth, a focus on health & well-being and an internal community that will set you up for success.

We offer an environment that enables colleagues to demonstrate their capabilities, focus on their work and create value. At LG, you're encouraged to take a creative and individual approach to challenges with strong emphasis placed on performance and skill—and equal, merit-based opportunities across the board. We want our colleagues to grow with our global business. That's why we deliver sure rewards for exceptional performance and offer industry-leading benefits. Come join the team!

The Opportunity

The Network Data Analyst
will act as the primary point of contact for managing and optimizing data from LG Field Service systems. This role focuses on building and automating data structures to improve field operations and enhance territory mapping analysis.

A key responsibility is visualizing Field Service performance through dynamic dashboards and automated reporting. The analyst will partner closely with cross-functional teams to develop, calculate, and analyze Field Service KPIs, identify trends and improvement opportunities, and deliver clear, actionable insights to leadership.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and performance trackers to support business visibility.
Utilize business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Google Data Studio, and Google Sheet to develop impactful data visualizations.
Prepare accurate operational reports and forecasts using BI platforms and ERP systems to help drive performance against goals.
Streamline and automate planning processes in partnership with analytics teams, leveraging key insights to support continuous improvement.
Gather, consolidate, and analyze data from multiple sources, transforming it into clear, actionable insights for leadership.
Support the development and execution of strategies to optimize LG’s preferred network coverage.
Perform detailed analyses of current processes, systems, and data flows to identify inefficiencies and recommend enhancements.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Develop geographic and territory map visualizations in Tableau to analyze network coverage.

Education / Experience (Requirements)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, or a related field (Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, etc.).
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, etc.) is required.
Experience with business intelligence tools and dashboard development (e.g., Tableau, Google Data Studio).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
Travel requirement: Typically less than 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

Bilingual proficiency in both Korean and English
Experience using SQL for data querying.
Experience with programming languages such as Python.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

$55,000—$73,000 USD

No-cost employee premiums for you and your eligible dependents for competitive medical, dental, vision and prescription benefits.
Auto enrollment with immediate vesting of competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options.
Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of paid sick and vacation time.
Performance based Short-Term Incentives (varies by role).

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts, data scientists, and engineers learn and grow together. You'll work with some of Stripe's most fundamental and exciting data, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business insights through analyses and data storytelling.

Responsibilities

Work with Treasury Finance, Finance & Strategy, Risk and Engineering to build out analytics and observability framework for Stripe's financial position
Investigate macro signals and build analytical frameworks that inform financial planning and strategic decisions
Develop targeted observability and performance analytics for both standard and event-driven environments, providing key insights to senior leadership on Stripe’s business position as macro/market conditions shift
Understand and leverage Stripe's data assets to analyze financial performance and develop scalable data foundations for existing and emerging analytical needs
Work with heterogeneous and unstructured data to develop insights and recommendations
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to build data pipelines, models, and infrastructure that serve business needs
Support ongoing reporting, stakeholder communications, and information requests across Treasury Finance and Finance & Strategy

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

Must be located in New York or willing to relocate as this role is hybrid
3–6 years of experience in Data Research & Analysis, Risk Modeling & Analysis roles, Business Intelligence and Data Engineering, building data pipelines and analyzing large datasets to solve problems
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Strong statistical knowledge and business intuition
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Experience in analytics in FinTech, banking, investment management, corporate finance, treasury, or financial services
Expertise in visualization and using data insights to make recommendations and achieve goals
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple concurrent projects with strong attention to detail
Comfortable collaborating across functions to identify data analytics problems and execute solutions with technical rigor and data-driven insights
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding

Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related technical field
Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or FinTech company
Prior experience in macro analytics, corporate finance, financial planning, and portfolio management
Familiarity with financial and accounting data, time-series data, macroeconomic analysis or economic indicator development
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Hadoop and Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing

The annual US base salary range for this role is $134,000 - $201,000. Problem-solving with a purpose.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. .

jobs.description:
Position Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Barrick, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people.

We are looking for a Senior Hydrogeologist to join our Fourmile Project Team. The successful candidate will routinely perform engineering and technical tasks relating to the site’s groundwater management, modeling, and remediation activities. This is a senior level position in which incumbents are expected to have a significant background in operational activities and regulatory compliance requirements regarding water use and reclamation.

At Barrick, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Responsibilities

Support the project manager in delivering the project by performing advanced technical hydrogeologic analysis, making strategic operational and closure recommendations, and leading and mentoring technical staff
Ensure that the required hydrogeologic data is collected, compiled, analyzed, interpreted, and applied so that dewatering costs and timelines for operational requirements are communicated accurately to stakeholders and management
Ensure that necessary hydrogeologic review of modeling and mine designs is conducted, and that potential risks and opportunities are identified and communicated to key stakeholders
Ensure on-going communication and cooperation with other departments/functional groups (geology, mine engineering, geotechnical engineering, mine operations, environmental, process, etc.) to optimize the ability for all groups to obtain the necessary information and/or accomplish a shared objective
Ensure that hydrogeologic work is budgeted, forecasted, and communicated appropriately for all projects
Interpret and analyze technical data pertaining to ground and surface water quantity and quality; rainfall and drainage; flood control; and water management, disposal, and reuse
Compile planning and design analyses based on independent critical evaluations and make recommendations pertaining to hydrogeologic issues including water handling
Prepare comprehensive reports regarding groundwater basins and surface water resources
Manage the formulation and administration of supporting consultant contracts, may formulate and/or use computer models to evaluate hydrogeologic technical details
The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in hydrogeology, geology, civil engineering (or similar) is required
Ten (10) years of experience in the mining industry is preferred
Familiarity with water well systems, hydraulic flow, and well field balancing is preferred
Knowledge of advanced principles and practices employed in hydrogeology and hydrology preferred
Ability to compile and analyze complex hydrogeologic data; prepare reports and comprehensive studies, and communicate findings effectively in written and oral formats preferred
Familiarity with hydrogeologic modeling techniques is required
Experience formulating hydrogeologic models is highly preferred
Knowledge of regulatory constraints related to water management activities preferred

What We Can Offer You

A comprehensive compensation package including a competitive medical, dental, and vision plan with national provider networks, a 401k retirement plan with employer contribution, paid time off, company-sponsored medical clinics, company match share purchase program, and much more!
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
Opportunities to grow and learn with the industry colleagues are endless.
Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization.
Barrick is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

About Us

Our mission is to be the world’s most valued gold and copper mining business. We are committed to partnering with our host countries and communities to transform their natural resources into tangible benefits and mutual prosperity.

Barrick is a leading global mining, exploration and development company. With one of the largest portfolios of world-class and life-long gold and copper assets in the industry - including six of the world's Tier One gold mines - Barrick's operations an projects span 18 countries and five continents. Barrick is also the largest gold producer in the United States. We create real, long-term value for all stakeholders through responsible mining, strong partnerships, and a disciplined approach to growth. Barrick shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "B" and on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "ABX".

About The Team

Nevada Gold Mines (NGM) is a joint venture between Barrick (61.5%) and Newmont (38.5%) that combined our significant assets across Nevada in 2019 to create the single largest gold-producing complex in the world. NGM produces approximately 3.5 million ounces of gold a year. The massive mining operation comprises eight mines along with their associated infrastructure and processing facilities and hosts three of Barrick’s Tier One assets: Carlin, Cortez, and Turquoise Ridge. At NGM, our mission is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and owning the best assets, with the best people, to deliver sustainable returns for our owners and partners.

The ideal candidate brings experience in quantitative finance, data analytics, and statistical modeling, with the ability to turn complex market data into practical client-ready products.

Exchange Data Analysis & Research

Use modeling, regression, and clustering methods to improve dataset quality and insight generation.

Conduct competitive analysis of market data and alternative data offerings.
Support sales and marketing with analytics and product positioning for client discussions.

Familiarity with machine learning techniques such as supervised learning, clustering, and anomaly detection.
Working knowledge of market data APIs, real-time data processing, or related infrastructure.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, AWS, or GCP is a plus.

Prior experience at a market data provider, exchange, or trading analytics firm.
Familiarity with cloud-based data processing (AWS, GCP, Azure) and distributed computing frameworks.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts, data scientists, and engineers learn and grow together. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business insights through analyses and data storytelling.

Responsibilities

Work with Treasury Finance, Finance & Strategy, Risk and Engineering to build out analytics and observability framework for Stripe's financial position
Investigate macro signals and build analytical frameworks that inform financial planning and strategic decisions
Develop targeted observability and performance analytics for both standard and event-driven environments, providing key insights to senior leadership on Stripe’s business position as macro/market conditions shift
Understand and leverage Stripe's data assets to analyze financial performance and develop scalable data foundations for existing and emerging analytical needs
Work with heterogeneous and unstructured data to develop insights and recommendations
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to build data pipelines, models, and infrastructure that serve business needs
Support ongoing reporting, stakeholder communications, and information requests across Treasury Finance and Finance & Strategy

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must be located in New York or willing to relocate as this role is hybrid
3–6 years of experience in Data Research & Analysis, Risk Modeling & Analysis roles, Business Intelligence and Data Engineering, building data pipelines and analyzing large datasets to solve problems
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Strong statistical knowledge and business intuition
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact

Comfortable collaborating across functions to identify data analytics problems and execute solutions with technical rigor and data-driven insights

Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related technical field
Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or FinTech company

new_jobs.title: Fourmile - Senior Hydrogeologist
new_jobs.description:
Position Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Barrick, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people.

We are looking for a Senior Hydrogeologist to join our Fourmile Project Team. The successful candidate will routinely perform engineering and technical tasks relating to the site’s groundwater management, modeling, and remediation activities. This is a senior level position in which incumbents are expected to have a significant background in operational activities and regulatory compliance requirements regarding water use and reclamation.

At Barrick, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Responsibilities

Support the project manager in delivering the project by performing advanced technical hydrogeologic analysis, making strategic operational and closure recommendations, and leading and mentoring technical staff
Ensure that the required hydrogeologic data is collected, compiled, analyzed, interpreted, and applied so that dewatering costs and timelines for operational requirements are communicated accurately to stakeholders and management
Ensure that necessary hydrogeologic review of modeling and mine designs is conducted, and that potential risks and opportunities are identified and communicated to key stakeholders
Ensure on-going communication and cooperation with other departments/functional groups (geology, mine engineering, geotechnical engineering, mine operations, environmental, process, etc.) to optimize the ability for all groups to obtain the necessary information and/or accomplish a shared objective
Ensure that hydrogeologic work is budgeted, forecasted, and communicated appropriately for all projects
Interpret and analyze technical data pertaining to ground and surface water quantity and quality; rainfall and drainage; flood control; and water management, disposal, and reuse
Compile planning and design analyses based on independent critical evaluations and make recommendations pertaining to hydrogeologic issues including water handling
Prepare comprehensive reports regarding groundwater basins and surface water resources
Manage the formulation and administration of supporting consultant contracts, may formulate and/or use computer models to evaluate hydrogeologic technical details
The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in hydrogeology, geology, civil engineering (or similar) is required
Ten (10) years of experience in the mining industry is preferred

Project Coordinator | Capital Markets & Business Operations | Remote Independent Contractor

Executive Agility is seeking expressions of interest from an experienced
Project Coordinator
to join our growing team. This remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement, is an execution & project coordination role with administrative, communication & delivery responsibilities across multiple concurrent projects.

The role combines project coordination, administration, client service, document control, communications & digital operations. The successful contractor must be highly organized, detail-driven, AI-literate & comfortable working with senior executives, boards, auditors, lawyers, bankers, contractors & clients.

🔷 WHO WE ARE

Executive Agility is the listing readiness quarterback for U.S. & Canadian capital markets. We help companies prepare for & execute domestic IPOs, up-listings, dual listings, cross-border listings, SPACs & de-SPACs.

We solve two problems: execution readiness & execution coordination. We diagnose the gaps, build the roadmap, execute governance, PCAOB audit & disclosure-readiness workstreams, deploy interim or fractional executives, place independent board directors & coordinate the critical path across counsel, auditors, bankers, boards & management.

Our role is to keep every workstream moving concurrently, not sequentially, so companies accelerate schedule, reduce costs & reduce execution risk.

🔷 THE ROLE

The Project Coordinator will:
✔ Manage project schedules, milestones & execution timelines
✔ Build & maintain Gantt charts, scorecards, trackers & KPI templates
✔ Track actions, risks, issues, decisions & deliverables in structured registers
✔ Coordinate information requests across clients, advisors, contractors & stakeholders
✔ Prepare concise status reports to keep leadership & clients informed
✔ Schedule & coordinate meetings, agendas, minutes, decisions & follow-up actions
✔ Maintain document control, version control & structured filing environments
✔ Coordinate Virtual Data Room setup, uploads, permissions & indexing
✔ Monitor designated inboxes, route emails & track client requests
✔ Handle client enquiries, scheduling, correspondence & follow-ups
✔ Coordinate contractor & candidate administration, records, onboarding documentation, agreements, SOWs & digital execution
✔ Maintain CRM, contact, contractor, candidate & project records
✔ Assist with proposals, presentations, reports, templates & routine business correspondence
✔ Coordinate social-media posting, content scheduling, website updates, outreach & email campaigns
✔ Use AI productivity tools to improve research, drafting, reporting, meeting documentation & workflow efficiency
✔ Identify delays, missing information & unresolved actions and escalate them promptly
✔ Ensure follow-through across assigned workstreams with minimal supervision.

🔷 ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

✔ Prior experience in project coordination, PMO support, project management.
✔ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams & deadlines
✔ Experience maintaining schedules, Gantt charts, trackers, registers & reports
✔ Strong administration capability, including inboxes, scheduling, records, communications & follow-up
✔ Strong written communication, client-service & reporting skills
✔ High discipline in document control, version control & information management
✔ Competence with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint & Excel
✔ Practical AI literacy and experience using generative-AI tools in business workflows
✔ Ability to work remotely, prioritize independently & deliver agreed outcomes
✔ Sound judgement, confidentiality, accuracy & attention to detail.

🔷 HIGH-VALUE EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

✔ CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Practising Project Practitioner or equivalent qualification
✔ Diploma of Project Management or similar qualification accompanied by practical project-management experience
✔ Capital-markets, IPO, governance, executive-search, legal, audit, finance, consulting or advisory experience
✔ Virtual Data Room or due-diligence coordination experience
✔ Experience supporting senior executives, boards or multi-advisor projects
✔ Experience with CRM, social media, website, email-campaign or contractor-administration workflows.

Practical project-management experience & portfolio evidence will be required.

🔷 YOUR PROFILE

✔ You create structure, visibility & accountability across complex work
✔ You are comfortable combining project coordination with detailed administration & client service
✔ You communicate professionally with executives, clients, advisors & contractors
✔ You can independently manage routine activities while escalating material issues promptly
✔ You can demonstrate schedules, Gantt charts, registers, dashboards, reports or workflows you have created
✔ You are dependable, responsive & able to keep multiple priorities moving without constant supervision.

🔷 ENGAGEMENT MODEL

✔ Remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement
✔ Variable hours based on client & business requirements

🔷 HOW TO APPLY

Apply via LinkedIn with a current CV. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly by Executive Agility for a confidential conversation.

Approaches from recruitment agencies will not be responded to.
